semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Nitta provides specialized tubing and fittings that are relevant for clean environments in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Nitta offers a range of clean products, including PFAS alternative tubing and fittings designed for semiconductor manufacturing environments. Their products focus on enhancing reliability, efficiency, and cleanliness in various applications, including ultrapure water and chemical handling.
